name: Xonotic

scale.why: player box 69 u tall (sv_player_mins z -24, sv_player_maxs z 45: xonotic-server.cfg#L85-86), scaled to 1.8 m: 0.02609 m/u

air_accel.note: strafe-only air: accel 18 toward 100 u/s (sv_maxairstrafespeed), mostly Quake-style (airstrafeaccel_qw -0.95 blends in 5% of a speed-keeping push); with forward too: accel 2 toward 360 u/s (sv_airaccelerate 2, qw -0.8)

air_cap.note: strafe-only air wish speed: close to Quark's 2.3 / 2.53 m/s

hook_cooldown.note: the off-hand hook is a mutator (g_grappling_hook 0 by default)

hook_max.note: Xonotic's hook pulls like a rubber band (force_rubber 2000) with this pull speed; not the same model as Quark's capped pull

dash_speed.note: dodging is a mutator, off by default (g_dodging 0); a double-tap dodge adds 400 u/s sideways and 200 u/s up over 0.1 s

dash_cooldown.note: the dodging mutator's delay (off by default)

dash.note: dodging exists as a mutator, off by default

grapple.note: the off-hand hook is a mutator, off by default

timeTo90.source: derived from this file's speed, ground_accel, friction, stop_speed
timeTo90.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; Quark: 0.072 s

stopDistance.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopDistance.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; Quark: 1.21 m

stopTime.source: derived from this file's speed, friction, stop_speed
stopTime.note: Quake ground model at 1 ms steps (friction then accelerate), the same way Quark's physsim measures its own run_up / stop presets; Quark: 0.364 s

extras: CPM-style air control 100 (sv_aircontrol 100, power 2) with W only
step 31 u (just under 32 u stairs), steps down at speed (sv_gameplayfix_stepdown 2)
the game ships other physics sets (physicsQ, Q3, CPMA, Warsow, Nexuiz) selectable by servers
notes: The default ruleset (physicsX.cfg). Xonotic's 9.4 m/s run, 6.8 m/s jump, 20.9 m/s2 gravity and 2.6 m/s strafe cap are the closest of any game here to Quark's 9.5 / 7.34 / 22 / 2.3.
